searchText: Not ironic, not realistic to think hashrate will increase. I threw some code together and my projection for the bomb is: ``` Block 14900000 on 04 Jun 08:00, 15.6 seconds per block Block 15000000 on 25 Jun 01:47, 17.9 seconds per block Block 15100000 on 21 Jul 02:48, 22.5 seconds per block Block 15200000 on 26 Aug 18:17, 31.7 seconds per block Block 15300000 on 23 Oct 14:41, 50.0 seconds per block ``` If the hashrate halves I instead project: ``` Block 14900000 on 05 Jun 06:34, 17.9 seconds per block Block 15000000 on 01 Jul 07:35, 22.5 seconds per block Block 15100000 on 06 Aug 23:04, 31.7 seconds per block Block 15200000 on 03 Oct 19:27, 50.0 seconds per block ``` Based on this I think unless we can set Mainnet TTD at the Jun 24th ACD, we should delay the bomb. Even if it's delayed for just 3 months it may help stopping the bad press and clients can ship merge ready stable releases at the same time can you share your code? these estimates seem much more pessimistic than others I have seen FWIW, here are my estimates Current Blocktime 14.01 Calculated hashrate: 1044 TH/s June 25th 15.63 July 25th 17.8 Aug 25th 25.13 Assuming flat hashrate Yeah, sorry. My code has a bug that makes my estimates garbage. for anyone interested. The method I used to get these numbers was to collect the blocktime and uncle status of the last 10k mainnet blocks and randomly sample them one block at a time for input into the difficulty calculation using the scaled blocktime (based on predicted parent diff/sampled difficulty) heres the code, please don't judge the python, I'm a weekend coder https://pastebin.com/3AxTfa8p Likely can assume declining hashrate as longer block times will mean people move off to other coins due to decreasing profits. I think all other coins combined=around 50ths so I’d say by 20 secs expect a 5-10% decrease in hashrate. Also there will be another 10-20% drop in hashrate in august as dag hits 5gb which will kick most ASICS and the few 5gb gpus off. What would be interesting is if we could estimate how much gas will increase with a 10% decrease in blocks.

excerpts.author: peter.davies
excerpts.content:
I threw some code together and my projection for the bomb is:
```
Block 14900000 on 04 Jun 08:00, 15.6 seconds per block
Block 15000000 on 25 Jun 01:47, 17.9 seconds per block
Block 15100000 on 21 Jul 02:48, 22.5 seconds per block
Block 15200000 on 26 Aug 18:17, 31.7 seconds per block
Block 15300000 on 23 Oct 14:41, 50.0 seconds per block
```
If the hashrate halves I instead project:
```
Block 14900000 on 05 Jun 06:34, 17.9 seconds per block
Block 15000000 on 01 Jul 07:35, 22.5 seconds per block
Block 15100000 on 06 Aug 23:04, 31.7 seconds per block
Block 15200000 on 03 Oct 19:27, 50.0 seconds per block
```
Based on this I think unless we can set Mainnet TTD at the Jun 24th ACD, we should delay the bomb.
